source.basis: Synthetic fixture "medium" generated by scripts/generate-fixtures.mjs from word lists and a seeded PRNG. Entity classifications are curated in the generator, not inferred. No live database or customer schema was inspected.

tables.name: v_fact_daily_sales_summary
tables.definition:
SELECT t.id, t.weight_grams, t.expires_at, t.status, t.effective_date, t.due_at, t.score
FROM analytics.fact_daily_sales AS t
WHERE t.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'

tables.name: v_fact_sessions_summary
tables.definition:
SELECT t.id, t.tax_total, t.subtotal, t.icon, t.error_code, t.category
FROM analytics.fact_sessions AS t
WHERE t.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'

tables.name: v_payments_summary
tables.definition:
SELECT t.id, t.unit, t.summary, t.starts_at, t.file_name, t.first_name, t.postal_code, t.byte_size, t.expires_at
FROM billing.payments AS t
WHERE t.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'

tables.name: v_quotes_summary
tables.definition:
SELECT t.id, t.postal_code, t.expiry_date, t.color, t.byte_size, t.subtotal
FROM ordering.quotes AS t
WHERE t.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'

tables.name: v_ticket_messages_summary
tables.definition:
SELECT t.id, t.deleted_at, t.unit, t.row_version, t.category, t.created_by
